pages.text: Cuts logs and stems into $(l)6 planks$() instead of 4, always with a bit of $(item)sawdust$(), and planks into 3 sticks. Uses 12 FE/t and has a battery slot.$(br2)Sawdust burns in furnaces, and 3 sawdust in a row make 2 paper. Datapacks can add recipes of type $(item)redcircuit:sawing$().
